description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Fiscal Strategy Statement and Budget Economic & Fiscal Position  Report - 2019
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the publication and availability of the Fiscal Management Report - 2019, which is issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. The content pertains to statutory compliance with a specific legal framework (reporting requirements mandated by law), making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organisational, or other specialized category.
